scope: Five questionable provisional men products checked at full 1350x1800 source resolution
boardTitle: Five provisional products · full-source correction audit
boardNote: One S139 Premium hold revoked · four retained with exact constraints or metadata correction · no outfit approval or UI integration

entries.label: Light-Blue Straight Drawstring Trouser
entries.reason: The full worn view proves a controlled straight ankle line, clean thigh and cheerful Summer blue without pooling. Keep only for Casual Everyday Mid-Range; the exposed drawcord and simple finishing exclude Office and Premium use.

entries.label: Dusty-Blue Open-Knit Sleeveless Polo
entries.reason: The useful color and regular body do not overcome the deep armholes, visible metal chest plaque and basic open-knit finishing. It cannot carry a Premium Zara-led outfit; retain only as an unassigned Mid-Range Casual or Resort possibility.

entries.label: Light-Apricot Asymmetric Cable Sweater
entries.reason: The source proves an upper-hip hem and intentional one-sided cable texture rather than an extra-long body. Keep only with the controlled dusty-blue straight jean and a light minimal shoe; no oversized outerwear or second loose layer.

entries.label: Medium-Gray Controlled-Straight Tailored Trouser
entries.reason: Despite the supplier title loose fit, the full worn view shows a clean waist, controlled straight leg and one restrained shoe break. It is suitable for Budget-Friendly Office when color is added above and the shoe is brown or oxblood.

entries.label: Pale Sage-Wash Straight Jean
entries.reason: The full source is controlled straight with one clean break, not broad or puddled. Correct the color from meaningless trousers/stone-gray to pale sage wash and anchor it with a darker knit plus the dusty-blue puffer for Winter Travel.
